name: Ichiyoshi Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Ichiyoshi Securities Co., Ltd. provides investment and financial services in Japan. The company is involved in corporate and investment research; agency for insurance; and investment advisory. It also provides non-discretionary advisory, and discretionary investment advisory, and investment trust management business. In addition, the company engages in real estate leasing, broking, agency, and management services; sale of office supplies and goods. Ichiyoshi Securities Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
